p|panel|hogar_suspension: Notice: this PC goes to sleep by itself (plugged in: {ac}; on battery: {dc}). While it sleeps, phones pointing only at it are left without DNS. Set it to “Never” in Settings › System › Power & battery › Screen and sleep, or add the router as secondary DNS on the phones.
p|panel|hogar_suspension_nunca: This PC does not go to sleep by itself. Good: the phones will not lose their DNS because of that.
p|panel|hueco: GUARDIANA was not watching between {desde} and {hasta}. It is on record.
p|panel|licencia_comprobacion_al_dia: Subscription: {periodo}. GUARDIANA checks the key 8 days after activation and then once per period: the next time on {fecha}; it is recorded below.
p|panel|licencia_comprobacion_pendiente: Subscription: {periodo}. The key is due for a check; GUARDIANA will do it on its next pass. If it cannot, it retries every hour and keeps everything for 7 more days; only after that would it move to Free.
p|panel|licencia_comprobacion_fallida: Subscription: {periodo}. The key could not be checked: there was no connection to the gateway, or its answer could not be understood. GUARDIANA retries hourly; if it does not manage before {limite}, it will move to Free and keep watching this computer.
p|panel|licencia_comprobacion_rechazada: Subscription: {periodo}. The payment gateway says the key is no longer valid (after a refund, a failed payment or after disabling it, for instance). GUARDIANA asks again every hour; if on {limite} it still says so, it will move to Free. If you think this is a mistake, write to hola@guardianagroup.com.
p|panel|licencia_comprobacion_no_toca: The subscription is not due for a check yet.
p|panel|licencia_de_por_vida: Lifetime license: paid once, it does not expire. GUARDIANA checks the key when it can, but the license is never switched off for a check that could not be done: not offline, not with the computer off for months. The only thing that ends it is the gateway saying it is no longer valid, after a refund for instance, and then it is said here with its date.
p|panel|licencia_de_por_vida_rechazada: The payment gateway now says the key is no longer valid (after a refund, for instance). GUARDIANA asks again every hour; if on {fecha} it still says so, the license ends that day and GUARDIANA moves to Free. If you think this is a mistake, write to hola@guardianagroup.com.
p|panel|licencia_plus_cancelada: The gateway says the subscription ended on {fecha}. GUARDIANA keeps watching this computer on Free; what was written down stays on your disk. If a payment failed and you have sorted it out, type your key here again: GUARDIANA checks it and Plus is back, with Home Mode as you had it.
p|panel|licencia_plus_sin_comprobar: GUARDIANA could not check the subscription during the 7 days of grace and moved to Free on {fecha}: it keeps watching this computer. It keeps trying every hour: as soon as the gateway answers that the key is valid, Plus comes back on its own, with no need to type the key again.

p|panel|ia_lead: An artificial-intelligence agent on your computer works with your keys: your folders, your accounts, your network. Here you see which services it talks to, from which device and when.
p|panel|ia_limite: GUARDIANA checks where it talks, not what it reads. It sees service names; it does not see the files a program opens nor what travels inside each connection. What leaves through an app’s own encrypted DNS or a VPN does not pass through here either, and is recorded when detected.
p|panel|ia_servicios_titulo: AI services seen in the last 7 days
p|panel|ia_servicios_lead: From our open list of artificial-intelligence services. One showing up does not mean it is doing anything wrong: it means that device looked it up.
p|panel|ia_sin_servicios: No AI service seen in this home yet.
p|panel|ia_ocultos: There are {n} devices that do not share their detail with the home panel: their AI services are not shown here.
p|panel|ia_ocultos_uno: There is 1 device that does not share its detail with the home panel: its AI services are not shown here.
p|panel|alcance_titulo: Limit what an AI can use
p|panel|alcance_lead: Leaving a task to an AI (Claude, ChatGPT…)? Tell GUARDIANA what it needs and it will tell you if it connects to anything else. With Guard Mode on, it also blocks it.
p|panel|alcance_nuevo_lead: One service per line. The domain and everything under it counts: writing github.com includes api.github.com. Once saved it appears above, with the Guard Mode switch so it also blocks what falls outside.
p|panel|alcance_lineas_malas: I cannot read these lines as the name of a service: {lineas}. Write just the name, for example github.com or api.openai.com (a whole address, with https://, works too).
p|panel|alcance_guardado: Saved. GUARDIANA is now watching this computer.
p|panel|alcance_borrado: Scope removed: this device has nothing declared again.
p|panel|alcance_fuera: {n} names beyond what was declared in 24 hours
p|panel|alcance_fuera_uno: 1 name beyond what was declared in 24 hours
p|panel|alcance_fuera_ninguno: Nothing beyond what was declared in the last 24 hours.
p|panel|alcance_no_comparte: This device does not share its detail with the home panel: what went beyond the declared list is only visible from the device itself, in “My device”. Guard Mode works all the same.
p|panel|alcance_esperado_nota: System updates, certificates, the system’s own security and connectivity checks, time, recognized messaging and video calls, and what GUARDIANA needs for its license never count as “beyond”: they belong to the computer itself, not to the agent.
p|panel|alcance_limite: This checks destinations, not intentions: it says which services a device tried to reach, not what it did with them nor which files it opened. An agent working only with files on your disk does not show up here, because it asks for no name.
p|panel|alcance_paso1: 1. Which computer is the AI working on?
p|panel|alcance_paso2: 2. Which AI does it use? Tap the ones it needs
p|panel|alcance_paso3: 3. Anything else? Other services, one per line (optional)

Changing the system DNS and the service that starts by itself do work on all three.
